critique.evidence: Frame delivery is stable on mobile and tablet (~16.67 ms average, 16.8 ms worst, 0 long frames); desktop is less consistent at 20.73 ms average and 33.4 ms worst. Standard-mode sampling captured no active animation or changed elements at any viewport, so easing, choreography, and interaction feedback are not demonstrated. Reduced-motion mode visually changed nothing, but still reported one active animation and 195–222 transition-bearing elements, preventing a clean accessibility pass.
critique.fix: Provide measured frames for actual load and interaction transitions across all viewports. Under prefers-reduced-motion, eliminate the remaining active animation and replace blanket transitions with narrowly targeted properties. Bring desktop animation timing consistently near 16.7 ms per frame without ~33 ms spikes.
